prompt: Create a bright mixed-media anime illustration of two cheerful fox-eared hiking girls, Alma, walking side by side on a wooden boardwalk through a lush alpine wetland at Chisenupuri mountain. Use a realistic outdoor landscape background with green marsh grasses, reflective water channels, dense forest, a rounded mountain in the distance, and a vivid blue sky with soft white clouds. The girls should be full-body anime characters composited naturally into the scene: both have golden-brown fox ears, short fluffy light-brown/blonde hair, amber eyes, happy open-mouth expressions, backpacks, hiking boots, and outdoor trekking clothes. The left girl wears an oversized dark red plaid hooded jacket, black shorts, black hiking boots, and a backpack, walking casually with one hand near her backpack strap. The right girl wears a beige hiking jacket, brown shorts over black leggings, purple socks, tan hiking boots, a backpack harness, and holds one black trekking pole while pointing upward with her other hand. Behind each girl is one large translucent iridescent bubble-shaped fox tail, for a total of exactly 2 bubble tails, shaped like soft rounded fox tails with pastel rainbow highlights and transparent glassy edges. Add exactly 12 floating soap bubbles of varied sizes around the scene: 6 on the left side of the image including one large cropped foreground bubble at the bottom-left, and 6 on the right side including one large bubble near the lower-right. Style the characters with clean high-quality anime line art, soft cel shading, detailed hair and clothing folds, while the scenery remains naturalistic and sunlit. Composition should be horizontal 4:3, eye-level, lively and whimsical, no text, no watermark, no extra characters.
